title: What Changes When PLA Meets Plasma
source_visual_limits: This is the 2021 continuous PLA film/aluminium lamination study, not the distinct 2020 electrospun antimicrobial scaffold paper.
human_review: NOT APPROVED — listen, watch, verify panel identities and licensing before live embed
narrator: Kokoro ONNX, synthetic, not a real researcher narration

headline: THE PEEL
TELLS THE STORY
chapters.narration: The question was practical: could modifying a plant based PLA film make it adhere more strongly to aluminium? The peel test would give the answer.

headline: ACTIVATE
THE SURFACE
chapters.narration: Cold plasma changes the outermost polymer surface, creating reactive sites. The study then grafted ascorbic or fumaric acid onto the treated PLA film.

headline: WHAT WATER
REVEALS
chapters.eyebrow: FIGURE 1 · CONTACT ANGLE AND SURFACE ENERGY
chapters.narration: The authors measured contact angles and surface free energy. Both help characterize wetting, but neither measurement alone proves stronger laminate adhesion.

headline: CHEMISTRY
AT THE SURFACE
chapters.narration: The X ray photoelectron spectra belong to this exact PLA film paper. They help characterize the chemistry of the surface after the treatments.

headline: THE PEEL
EXPERIMENT
chapters.narration: This published figure compares peel resistance of untreated PLA, plasma treated samples, grafted samples, and blind controls without plasma activation.

headline: TO 211 N/m
chapters.narration: Untreated film averaged seventy four point four newtons per metre. The fumaric acid grafted sample reached two hundred eleven newtons per metre, the largest increase.

headline: THE CONTROL
CHANGES THE CLAIM
chapters.eyebrow: NO PLASMA · NO COMPARABLE ADHESION GAIN
chapters.narration: Adding the acids without prior plasma treatment gave results close to untreated film. That blind control is central to how the researchers interpreted grafting.

headline: FILM IS NOT
SCAFFOLD
chapters.narration: These results describe PLA film and aluminium peel adhesion. They must not be illustrated with the separate twenty twenty antimicrobial electrospun scaffold experiment.
